# Oscilar

Oscilar: An AI-powered platform providing real-time risk detection for secure online transactions.

Palo Alto, CA, US

Founded with the mission to make the internet a safer place, Oscilar offers a groundbreaking AI-powered risk decisioning platform designed to protect online transactions from fraud, theft, and other risks. The company integrates real-time data, artificial intelligence, and decision-making processes to create an advanced credit and fraud detection system. Oscilar primarily serves fintech companies, providing them with a no-code solution to manage fraud, credit, and compliance risks effectively.

Oscilar has attracted attention from notable investors and industry experts due to its innovative approach to risk management. The platform's real-time capabilities and AI-driven insights have set new standards in the industry, earning it recognition for significantly enhancing transaction security. # 海外New Things |利用AI保障在线交易安全，「Oscilar」自筹2000万美元

石头学习笔记·2023年04月17日 17:49

Oscilar的不同之处在于该平台依赖人工智能和机器学习，需要客户提供有关欺诈事件的数据进行后续训练。同时，Oscilar提供工具包供风险操作团队创建、测试、监控和新的风险模型，这使团队不必再依赖工程师提供技术支持。

文 | Ricky

编辑 | 王与桐

3月30日，金融科技初创公司Oscilar宣布成立，为方便加快建立、扩大公司规模，Oscilar由Confluent创始人Neha Narkhede与Sachin Kulkarni 自筹2000万美元成立。据悉，该公司致力于开发人工智能驱动平台，保障金融机构在线交易，减少欺诈、盗窃等事件的发生。

Oscilar创立前，Kulkarni担任Facebook高级工程总监，领导Facebook私有云构建部门。同时Narkhede担任LinkedIn高管，负责监督网络的数据管道规模。尽管公司内部不乏世界顶尖的工程人才，但风险决策技术的繁琐和低效依然无法有效地解决。Narkhede表示：“我们深信欺诈和风险决策技术需要彻底改革，过去两年我们一直努力工作，希望能建立一家公司来解决这个问题。”

疫情进一步加速了在线交易的爆炸式增长，欺诈、信贷和保险风险上升。世界银行2022年的一项调查发现，全球三分之二的成年人现在进行或接受数字支付。与此同时，Juniper Research预计，到2025年，在线支付欺诈造成的损失将超过2000亿美元。

安全支付市场的竞争非常激烈，不久前，Nivelo为其保护ACH交易的平台启动了250万美元的种子基金；Sardine获得5150万美元，用于开发金融科技支付的异常检测技术。该领域的其他竞争者包括Fraugster、Bounc

###### about oscilar

# Empowering businesses to master risk, defeat fraud, and safeguard consumers in the era of AI.

[Get a Demo]

Oscilar has developed the most advanced AI Risk Decisioning platform that helps banks, fintechs, credit unions, and digital organizations manage onboarding, credit, fraud, and compliance risks. It's built by the same team that created advanced risk management platforms at Facebook, Uber, LinkedIn, Citi, and JPMorganChase.

###### ORIGINS

Neha Narkhede co-created Apache Kafka and founded Confluent (NASDAQ: CFLT).

After growing Confluent to be a world leading, $10B real time data streaming platform, she decided to work on an even bigger problem: making the internet a safer place for everyone.

Neha assembled an AI-first team of top risk and Machine Learning engineers to develop the most advanced AI Risk Decisioning platform.
